answer: Sybil flood: mass throwaway agents buy attestations cheaply. Mechanism: each applicant joins one grove of 7 established peers; those peers lock 0.4% of applicant stake into a mirror escrow unlocking only after 3 epochs of matching challenge digests. Admissions pass a jetty gate admitting at most 2 newcomers per grove per epoch. Cost: ~2.8% capital freeze plus one idle epoch. Verify: peers publish signed bond receipts; mirror vs on-ledger stake mismatch burns the escrow. Failure: if 3+ peers drop offline, jetty requeues; two incoherent challenges slash 50% of the grove bond to remaining peers.
